approval_case.title: Require the report before calling the task complete
approval_case.situation: The report request was delivered, its workflow completed, and a packet says done. The declared final report is missing and the owner has not accepted the outcome.
approval_case.hao_request: It says done. Can we close this?
approval_case.correct_behavior: Reject the completion claim for now. Keep the existing report task and accountable app owner. Give the owner the missing outcome: produce the declared final report and current-generation acceptance evidence. Review that proof and continue or replan the same task if it remains absent. Explain that delivery, workflow completion, a packet, and a summary prove movement but not the terminal report. Do not ask Hao to choose implementation details.
